Get launch updates

Apps that put small sellers and workers to work.

Tensus Technologies is a Tamil Nadu-based company building InstaSell, a store and order tracker for Instagram and WhatsApp sellers, and Woorker, a job and shift platform. Both are launching soon.

See the appsJoin the launch list
Launching soon

InstaSell: your store, orders and tracking in one app.

Instagram and WhatsApp sellers get a store page their customers can browse, order from and track. Buyers see delivery fees and return policy before they pay.

Screens are from the working prototype, shown with sample products.

Pick the colour that fits your store.

InstaSell comes in bright themes and a dark mode, so every seller's app feels like theirs.

Launching soon

Woorker: find work, fill shifts.

Part-time, full-time and gig jobs for workers across India, with identity checks, location-verified attendance and escrow payments built in.

The job seeker app

Find a shift nearby, apply, show up and get paid.
